parsed_design.design_rationale: Increase compliance to fix 0.78mm stroke deficit: minimize thickness to strict limit 0.6mm and maximize beam length to envelope limits (86mm span, ~40mm per side). Keep symmetric double-parallelogram with tall intermediate stage so lower ground-intermediate and upper intermediate-output beams stay horizontal for pure Y motion, preserving zero parasitic dx/theta. Lower stiffness raises stroke ~2x while thinner leaves keep stress below 25MPa.
